summary: The extraction is accurate. All four main theorems are recorded with the right expressions, high-probability qualifiers, settings and registry ids. The appendix theorems only restate them and the Freedman inequality is a technical tool, so leaving them out is correct. Cited results are recorded the way the paper states them.
